source_row.rationale: Magnesium sulfate's primary evidence-based indication in severe preeclampsia is seizure prophylaxis, preventing progression to eclampsia, rather than functioning as a primary blood pressure-lowering agent.
source_row.source_name: ACOG — Preeclampsia and Eclampsia Management Guidelines
